# openmetadata_query (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata query. A query records SQL text against the database service that ran it. Destroy is a soft delete: the SDK exposes no delete call and the server hard-deletes only ancestor containers, so `terraform destroy` marks the query deleted and hides it from normal reads.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_database_service" "warehouse" {
  name         = "warehouse"
  service_type = "Postgres"
  description  = "Warehouse database service."
}

resource "openmetadata_query" "recent_orders" {
  service      = openmetadata_database_service.warehouse.fully_qualified_name
  name         = "recent_orders"
  display_name = "Recent orders"
  description  = "Orders placed in the last day."
  query        = "SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 day'"
}

output "recent_orders_query_id" {
  value = openmetadata_query.recent_orders.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `query` (String) SQL text of the query.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the database service the query runs against. Changing it replaces the query.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the query.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `name` (String) Query name. When omitted the server derives one from the query text. Changing it replaces the query, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name, in the form service.name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_query.recent_orders 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, in the form service.name.
terraform import openmetadata_query.recent_orders warehouse.recent_orders
```
